mia (devex): Hey team, running into a weird combo: pnpm workspace + exports map + edge bundler = sample app can't find typings and ESM import fails.

mia (devex): Error in browser: "The requested module '@redwood/sdk' does not provide an export named 'createClient'". In Node dev it shows "Could not find declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'" in editor.

lee (eng-runtime): quick details? package.json for sdk, node/pnpm versions, and whether consumer uses symlinked workspace or installed package?

mia (devex): pnpm 8.6, node 18.16, workspace symlink. sdk package.json exports currently only list the dist esm file as a subpath (e.g. "./dist/esm/index.mjs": "./dist/esm/index.mjs") and types is set to dist/index.d.ts. No root '.' export.

omar (eng-ml): That matches a common pattern: bundlers and Node expect a root export. Without '.' consumers that import from the package root can fail. TS editors sometimes need top-level "types" plus built d.ts present in workspace.

lee (eng-runtime): fix options: 1) add root exports mapping with import->esm and require->cjs, 2) keep top-level "types":"dist/index.d.ts", 3) ensure built d.ts exists in workspace (or publish). For edge samples prefer import-only to avoid bundlers pulling CJS.

mia (devex): short-term I changed sample-app to import the explicit esm subpath and rebuilt workspace; editor still complains until I run a build to generate d.ts. Not great for onboarding.

omar (eng-ml): long-term: update SDK package.json, add CI smoke that installs sample-app as workspace consumer (symlink) and runs edge bundler + a TypeScript editor check. Also add a small section in devex docs about pnpm symlink quirks and preserve-symlinks during debugging.

dev-bot: created issue #1523: "SDK exports + workspace edge smoke test" and queued pipeline job.

mia (devex): will open a PR with package.json change and a short README note for sample-app showing the workspace workaround. Thanks!
